tools.name: wiki_query
tools.description: Read-only search over the guarded personal wiki: canonical pages only (pending proposals stay invisible), results cite wiki paths and original sources, and not-found is reported explicitly. Wiki text is curated personal knowledge, not verified truth.

tools.name: wiki_propose
tools.description: Capture one owner-approved source and submit draft wiki pages as a pending proposal; returns the exact content digest. Never approves or publishes: publication happens on the configured writer via wiki.py — after a per-digest human approval, or under the owner standing approval recorded in the wiki's REVIEW.md.
